fields.name: ROW ID
fields.description: A unique sequential number, running from the first record to the last.

fields.name: BANK CODE
fields.description: Bank clearing code of the reporting bank as issued by Kenya Banker's Association (KBA)

fields.name: BUSINESS REPORTING DAY, MONTH & YEAR
fields.description: The reporting date, Month & Year based on the frequency. Format {DD-MMM- YYYY}

fields.name: CURRENCY CODE
fields.description: ISO currency codes as per ISO-4217. {e.g. USD, GPB, EUR, KES. etc.}

fields.name: TOTAL NUMBER OF ACTIVE CREDIT CARD
fields.description: Total count of the number of active credit cards.
fields.payload_key: TOTAL NO OF ACTIVE CREDIT CARD

fields.name: TOTAL CREDIT CARD LIMITS IN FCY
fields.description: Total amount of credit card limits in foreign currency
fields.payload_key: TOTAL CREDIT CARD LIMIT IN FCY

fields.name: TOTAL CREDIT CARD LIMITS IN LCY EQUIVALENT
fields.description: Total amount of credit card limits in local currency equivalent
fields.payload_key: TOTAL CREDIT CARD LIMIT IN LCY

fields.name: TOTAL CREDIT CARD AMOUNT UTILISED IN FCY
fields.description: Amount Utilised in foreign currency as at the reporting date
fields.payload_key: TOTAL CREDIT CARD AMT UTIL FCY

fields.name: TOTAL CREDIT CARD AMOUNT UTILISED IN LCY EQUIVALENT
fields.description: Amount Utilised in local currency equivalent as at the reporting date
fields.payload_key: TOTAL CREDIT CARD AMT UTIL LCY

fields.name: TOTAL NON-PERFORMING CREDIT CARD AMOUNT IN FCY
fields.description: Total amount in foreign currency of non- performing credit cards.
fields.payload_key: TOTAL NP CREDIT CARD AMT FCY

fields.name: TOTAL NON-PERFORMING CREDIT CARD AMOUNT IN LCY EQUIVQLENT
fields.description: Total amount in foreign currency of non- performing credit cards.
fields.payload_key: TOTAL NP CREDIT CARD AMT LCY
